en.s: The Treaty of Andelot (or Pact of Andelot) was signed at Andelot-Blancheville in 587 between King Guntram of Burgundy and Queen Brunhilda of Austrasia. Based on the terms of the accord, Brunhilda agreed that Guntram adopt her son Childebert II as his successor and ally himself with Childebert against the revolted leudes.
en.n: Treaty of Andelot: King Guntram of Burgundy recognizes Childebert II as his heir.

zh.s: 安德洛条约又称安德洛协定，于587年由勃艮第国王贡特朗和奥斯特拉西亚王后布伦希尔德在安德洛-布朗什维尔签订。根据条约，布伦希尔德同意让贡特朗收养她的儿子希尔德贝尔特二世作为继承人，并与希尔德贝尔特结盟，对抗叛乱的贵族。
zh.n: 勃艮第国王贡特朗承认希尔德贝尔特二世为继承人。

en.t: Shi Jingtang is enthroned as the first emperor of the Later Jin by Emperor Taizong of Liao, following a revolt against Emperor Fei of Later Tang
en.s: Shi Jingtang (Chinese: 石敬瑭; 30 March 892 – 28 July 942), also known by his temple name as the Emperor Gaozu of Later Jin (後晉高祖), was the founding emperor of the Later Jin dynasty of China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period, reigning from 936 until his death. Shi was an ethnic Shatuo and was an important military general for the Later Tang before rebelling in 936.

zh.t: 石敬瑭在辽太宗支持下登基，成为后晋开国皇帝；此前他反叛后唐废帝
zh.s: 石敬瑭（892年3月30日—942年7月28日），庙号后晋高祖，是中国五代十国时期后晋开国皇帝，在位时间为936年至去世。他是沙陀人，曾是后唐的重要军事将领，后于936年起兵反叛。

en.s: The siege of Toron was a military engagement between the armies of the German Crusade and the Ayyubid garrison of Toron. The Crusader army besieged the city from November 1197 to February 1198. The siege failed the Crusader forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 德国十字军与托隆的阿尤布驻军之间爆发了托隆围城战。十字军从1197年11月围困该城至1198年2月，最终未能攻下。

en.s: The Liberation of Krujë (Albanian: Çlirimi i Krujës) was the capture of the city of Krujë from the Ottoman Empire by Skanderbeg on 28 November 1443. It marks the start of Skanderbeg's rebellion and is an important event in Albanian history.

zh.s: 1443年11月28日，斯坎德培从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取阿尔巴尼亚克鲁亚城。这标志着斯坎德培起义的开始，也是阿尔巴尼亚历史上的重要事件。

en.t: After 38 days, an expedition under the command of Ferdinand Magellan completes the first passage through the Strait of Magellan and enters the Pacific Ocean
en.s: Ferdinand Magellan (c. 1480 – 27 April 1521) was a Portuguese explorer best known for planning and leading the 1519–1522 Spanish expedition to the East Indies. During this expedition, he became the first European to encounter the Strait of Magellan, performed the first European crossing of the Pacific Ocean, and made the first known European contact with the Philippines.

zh.t: 费迪南·麦哲伦率领的探险队历经38天，首次穿越麦哲伦海峡并进入太平洋
zh.s: 费迪南·麦哲伦（约1480年—1521年4月27日）是葡萄牙探险家，最著名的事迹是策划并率领1519—1522年西班牙东印度群岛远征。远征期间，他成为首位到达麦哲伦海峡的欧洲人，率队完成欧洲人首次横渡太平洋，并首次与菲律宾建立欧洲人已知的接触。

en.s: The Battle of Mollahasanli took place on 28 November 1578 during the Ottoman–Safavid War (1578–1590) in the town of Mollahasanli on the banks of the Agsu River in Shirvan. The Safavid army, under the command of the Crown Prince Hamza Mirza, defeated the army of the Ottoman ally, the Crimean Khan, under the command of the kalga Adil Giray. Adil Giray himself was captured.

zh.s: 1578年11月28日，奥斯曼—萨法维战争（1578—1590年）期间，双方在希尔万阿格苏河畔的莫拉哈桑利镇交战。哈姆扎·米尔扎王储率领的萨法维军队击败了奥斯曼帝国盟友克里米亚汗国的军队，后者由卡尔盖阿迪勒·吉雷指挥。阿迪勒·吉雷本人被俘。

en.s: The Capture of Santiago was a military engagement that took place between 11 and 28 November 1585 during the newly declared Anglo-Spanish War. (Santiago is the largest island of the Cape Verde archipelago.) An English expedition led by Francis Drake captured the port town of Cidade Velha in the Cape Verde islands that had recently belonged to the Crown of Portugal.

zh.s: 圣地亚哥岛之战是英西战争刚刚宣战后的一场军事行动，发生于1585年11月11日至28日。圣地亚哥岛是佛得角群岛中最大的岛屿。弗朗西斯·德雷克率领的英国远征军攻占了佛得角群岛的港口城镇旧城，当时该群岛不久前仍属于葡萄牙王室。

en.s: The Battle of Kroppenhof was fought during the Polish–Swedish War (1621–1625), between Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Swedish Empire in November 28, 1621. Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under the command of Aleksander Gosiewski defeated the Swedish forces commanded by Samuel Cockburn.

zh.s: 1621年11月28日，波兰立陶宛联邦与瑞典帝国在波瑞战争（1621—1625年）期间于克罗彭霍夫交战。亚历山大·戈谢夫斯基率领的波兰立陶宛联邦军队击败了塞缪尔·科克伯恩指挥的瑞典军队。

en.s: The Battle of Oliwa, also known as the Battle of Oliva or the Battle of Gdańsk Roadstead, was a naval battle that took place on 28 November, 1627, slightly north of the port of Danzig (Gdańsk) off of the coast of the village of Oliva during the Polish–Swedish War.

zh.s: 奥利瓦海战又称奥利瓦战役或格但斯克海战，是1627年11月28日发生在但泽（格但斯克）港口以北、奥利瓦村外海的一场海战，属于波瑞战争的一部分。

en.t: Founding fellows of the Royal Society hold their first meeting in London
en.s: On November 28, 1660, the founding fellows of what became the Royal Society met at Gresham College in London after a lecture by Christopher Wren. They formed a group to study the natural world through observation and experiment. The society received its royal charter later.
en.n: This records the founding meeting, not the later royal charter.

zh.t: 皇家学会创始成员在伦敦首次集会
zh.s: 1660年11月28日，后来创立皇家学会的一批学者在伦敦格雷沙姆学院听完克里斯托弗·雷恩的讲座后开会。他们决定组成团体，通过观察和实验研究自然界。皇家学会的王室特许状是后来才获得的。
zh.n: 此条记录首次集会，不是后来获得王室特许状的日期。

en.t: At Gresham College, twelve men, including Christopher Wren, Robert Boyle, John Wilkins, and Sir Robert Moray decide to found what is later known as the Royal Society
en.s: Sir Robert Moray (alternative spellings: Murrey, Murray) FRS (1608 or 1609 – 4 July 1673) was a Scottish soldier, statesman, diplomat, judge, spy, and natural philosopher. He was well known to Charles I and Charles II, and to the French cardinals Armand Richelieu and Jules Mazarin. He attended the meeting of the 1660 committee of 12 on 28 November 1660 that led to the formation of the Royal Society, and was influential in gaining its Royal Charter and formulating its statutes and regulations.

zh.t: 格雷沙姆学院12人会议决定创立后来被称为英国皇家学会的组织
zh.s: 苏格兰军人、政治家、外交官、法官、间谍和自然哲学家罗伯特·莫雷于1608年或1609年出生，1673年7月4日去世。他曾出席1660年11月28日由12人组成的委员会会议，该会议促成皇家学会成立。他还推动学会获得皇家特许状，并参与制定章程和规章。

en.s: The Battle of Rullion Green in the Pentland Hills, in Lothian, Scotland on 28 November 1666 was the culmination of the brief Pentland Rising (15–28 November 1666). At least 3000 men of the Scottish Royal Army led by Tam Dalyell of the Binns opposed about 900 Covenanter rebels. The Pentland Rising was in the context of the long-running government campaign to impose episcopalianism upon Scotland. The uprising began in St. John’s Town of Dalry, where troops were beating an elderly man who had defaulted on a fine for not attending government-approved church services.

zh.s: 1666年11月28日，苏格兰洛锡安奔特兰丘陵发生鲁利恩格林之战，这是短暂的奔特兰起义（1666年11月15日至28日）的最后一战。塔姆·戴利尔率领至少3000名苏格兰王家军，与约900名圣约盟军起义者交战。当时，政府长期试图在苏格兰推行主教制。起义始于圣约翰镇达尔里，当地士兵殴打一名因未参加政府认可的教会礼拜而拖欠罚款的老人。

en.s: The Raid on Saratoga was an attack by a French and Indian force on the settlement of Saratoga, New York on November 28, 1745, during King George's War. Led by Paul Marin de la Malgue, the allied force of 600 burned the settlement, killing about 30 and taking 60 to 100 prisoners, in addition.

zh.s: 1745年11月28日，乔治王战争期间，一支由法国人和印第安人组成的部队袭击了纽约州萨拉托加定居点。保罗·马兰·德·拉马尔格率领600人的联军烧毁了该定居点，约30人被杀，另有60至100人被俘。

en.s: Three agreements, each known as a Treaty of Hopewell, were signed between representatives of the Congress of the United States and the Cherokee, Choctaw, and Chickasaw peoples. They were negotiated and signed at the Hopewell plantation in South Carolina over 45 days during the winter of 1785–86. The treaties were signed at the plantation owned by General Andrew Pickens, which the treaty texts refer to as "Hopewell on the Keowee".
en.n: The first Treaty of Hopewell is signed, by which the United States acknowledges Cherokee lands in what is now East Tennessee.

zh.s: 美国国会代表与切罗基族、乔克托族和奇克索族分别签署了三份协议，每份都称为《霍普韦尔条约》。谈判和签署在1785至1786年冬季历时45天，于南卡罗来纳州霍普韦尔种植园完成。种植园属于安德鲁·皮肯斯将军，条约文本称之为“基奥维河畔的霍普韦尔”。
zh.n: 第一份《霍普韦尔条约》签署，美国据此承认了切罗基人在今田纳西州东部的土地。

en.s: The siege of Roses (or siege of Rosas) began on 28 November 1794 and lasted until 4 February 1795 when the Spanish garrison abandoned the port and the forces of the First French Republic took control. Dominique Catherine de Pérignon commanded the French army and Domingo Salvator Izquierdo led the Spanish defenders. The siege took place during the War of the Pyrenees which was part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

zh.s: 罗塞斯围城战又称罗萨斯围城战，于1794年11月28日开始，持续至1795年2月4日。西班牙守军撤离港口后，法兰西第一共和国军队接管了当地。法军由多米尼克·卡特琳·德·佩里尼翁指挥，西班牙守军由多明戈·萨尔瓦多·伊斯基耶多率领。这场围城发生在比利牛斯战争期间，该战争属于法国大革命战争的一部分。

en.s: The 1803 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 28, 1803, in order to elect the governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor James Turner was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 1803年11月28日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举，选出州长。民主共和党籍现任州长詹姆斯·特纳没有对手，由北卡罗来纳州议会再次选任。

en.s: The Battle of Wischau occurred on 28 November 1805 between the Russian and French armies. The conflict resulted in a minor Russian success. It followed the action at Hollabrun and Schöngrabern, and preceded the Battle of Austerlitz. The relatively easy Russian victory convinced the Third Coalition Allies that the French army would be easy to beat, having reached the end of their supply and communication lines and having suffered several losses in previous weeks of fighting.

zh.s: 1805年11月28日，俄军与法军在维绍交战。战斗以俄军小胜告终。此前，双方在霍拉布伦和申格拉本交战；此后则发生奥斯特里茨战役。俄军的轻松胜利让第三次反法同盟的盟国相信，法军已经抵达补给和通信线的尽头，且此前几周连连受挫，容易被击败。

en.s: In the Battle of Alba de Tormes on 28 November 1809, an Imperial French corps commanded by François Étienne de Kellermann attacked a Spanish army led by Diego de Cañas y Portocarrero, Duke del Parque. Finding the Spanish army in the midst of crossing the Tormes River, Kellermann did not wait for his infantry under Jean Gabriel Marchand to arrive, but led the French cavalry in a series of charges that routed the Spanish units on the near bank with heavy losses.

zh.t: 阿尔瓦德托尔梅斯之战
zh.s: 1809年11月28日，弗朗索瓦-艾蒂安·德·凯勒曼指挥的法兰西帝国军团进攻迭戈·德·卡尼亚斯-波特卡雷罗公爵率领的西班牙军队。当时西班牙军队正在渡托尔梅斯河。凯勒曼没有等待让·加布里埃尔·马尔尚率领的步兵赶到，而是率法军骑兵多次冲锋，击溃了河近岸的西班牙部队并造成重大伤亡。

en.t: Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, premieres at the Gewandhaus in Leipzig
en.s: The Piano Concerto No. 5 in E♭ major, Op. 73, known as the Emperor Concerto in English-speaking countries, is a piano concerto composed by Ludwig van Beethoven. Beethoven composed the concerto in 1809 under salary in Vienna, and he dedicated it to Archduke Rudolf, who was his patron, friend, and pupil. Its public premiere was on 28 November 1811 in Leipzig, with Friedrich Schneider as the soloist and Johann Philipp Christian Schulz conducting the Gewandhaus Orchestra.

zh.t: 降E大调第五钢琴协奏曲，作品73号，在莱比锡布商大厦首演
zh.s: 降E大调第五钢琴协奏曲，作品73号，英语国家常称“皇帝协奏曲”，是路德维希·范·贝多芬创作的钢琴协奏曲。贝多芬于1809年在维也纳领薪创作，并题献给他的赞助人、朋友和学生鲁道夫大公。作品于1811年11月28日在莱比锡公开首演，由弗里德里希·施奈德担任独奏，约翰·菲利普·克里斯蒂安·舒尔茨指挥布商大厦管弦乐团。

en.s: The Battle of Frenchman’s Creek took place during the War of 1812 between Great Britain and the United States in the early hours of November 28, 1812, in the Crown Colony of Upper Canada, near the Niagara River. The operation was conceived as a raid to prepare the ground for a larger American invasion. The Americans succeeded in crossing the Niagara and landing at both of their points of attack. They achieved one of their two objectives before withdrawing but the invasion was subsequently called off, rendering useless what had been accomplished.

zh.s: 法裔溪之战发生于1812年战争期间。1812年11月28日凌晨，英国和美国在尼亚加拉河附近、上加拿大王室殖民地境内交战。美军原计划先发动袭击，为更大规模的入侵做准备。他们成功渡过尼亚加拉河，并在两个攻击点登陆；在撤退前完成了两个目标中的一个。但随后入侵计划被取消，使此前的行动失去意义。

en.s: The Battle of Viluma, also known as Battle of Sipe-Sipe, was a major battle in the South American wars of independence in which the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata (formerly the Spanish Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata) were decisively defeated in Upper Peru (now Bolivia) by the Royal Army of Viceroyalty of Peru.

zh.s: 维卢马之战又称西佩西佩战役，是南美独立战争中的一场重要战役。普拉塔河联合省（原西班牙拉普拉塔总督辖区）的军队在上秘鲁（今玻利维亚）被秘鲁总督辖区的王家军决定性击败。

en.s: The Sasradilaga rebellion was a military campaign of the Java War conducted by Yogyakarta noble Raden Aria Sasradilaga against Dutch forces. Sasradilaga, who had previously fought alongside Dutch forces, turned to join his brother-in-law Prince Diponegoro in revolt, attacking the Dutch in the Rembang region starting in November 1827. The Dutch were caught off-guard, before managing to gather forces for a counterattack which pushed Sasradilaga into a guerilla war.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨斯拉迪拉加叛乱是爪哇战争期间的一场军事行动，由日惹贵族拉登·阿里亚·萨斯拉迪拉加率军对抗荷兰军队。萨斯拉迪拉加此前曾与荷兰军队并肩作战，后来转而加入其姻亲迪波内戈罗王子麾下，于1827年11月起在伦邦地区袭击荷兰人。荷兰军队猝不及防，之后集结兵力反攻，迫使萨斯拉迪拉加转入游击战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Quebracho Herrado, fought on 28 November 1840 in the east of Córdoba Province, Argentina, was a victory for the Argentine federal army, led by former Uruguayan president, Brigadier Manuel Oribe over the Unitarian army led by Brigadier Juan Lavalle, during the Argentine Civil Wars.

zh.s: 1840年11月28日，阿根廷科尔多瓦省东部发生克夫拉乔埃拉多之战。此役发生在阿根廷内战期间，由前乌拉圭总统、准将曼努埃尔·奥里韦率领的阿根廷联邦军击败了准将胡安·拉瓦列率领的统一派军队。

en.s: The Battle of Caaguazú took place in Mercedes Department, in Corrientes Province, Argentina on 28 November 1841, during the Argentine Civil War, between the forces of Entre Ríos Province, commanded by brigadier Pascual Echagüe and Corrientes Province, under brigadier José María Paz, with a sound defeat of the Federal Party forces of Entre Ríos.

zh.s: 1841年11月28日，阿根廷内战期间，恩特雷里奥斯省准将帕斯夸尔·埃查圭率军与科连特斯省准将何塞·玛丽亚·帕斯率军在阿根廷科连特斯省梅赛德斯地区交战。恩特雷里奥斯省联邦党军队惨败。

Gen. John S. Marmaduke back into the Boston Mountains in northwestern Arkansas. The Battle of Cane Hill was part of a Confederate attempt to drive the Union forces back into Missouri and recapture ground lost during the Pea Ridge campaign of early 1862, when Union forces had secured parts of northern Arkansas. Now, Confederate General Thomas C.

zh.s: 凯恩山战役于1862年11月28日在美国阿肯色州华盛顿县爆发。詹姆斯·G·布朗特准将率领联邦军，将约翰·S·马马杜克准将率领的邦联军击退至阿肯色州西北部的波士顿山脉。此战是邦联军试图将联邦军赶回密苏里州、夺回1862年初皮里奇战役中失地的一部分；当时联邦军已控制阿肯色州北部的部分地区。

en.s: Association football, commonly known as football or soccer, is a team sport played between two teams of 11 players who mostly use their feet to kick an inflated ball around a pitch (playing field). The objective of the game is to score more goals than the opposing team by moving the ball into the rectangular-framed goal which that team defends.
en.n: Notts County F.C. is founded in Nottingham, England, making it the oldest professional Association football club in the world.

zh.s: 足球是一项团队运动，由两队各11名球员参加。球员主要用脚在球场上踢充气球，目标是把球踢进由对方防守的长方形球门，进球数超过对方。
zh.n: 诺茨郡足球俱乐部在英格兰诺丁汉成立，成为世界上历史最悠久的职业足球俱乐部。

en.s: The Battle of Buckhead Creek (also spelled as Buck Head Creek) or Battle of Reynolds' Plantation was the second battle of Sherman's March to the Sea, fought November 28, 1864, during the American Civil War. Union Army cavalry under Brig. Gen. Hugh Judson Kilpatrick repulsed an attack by the small Confederate cavalry corps under Maj. Gen. Joseph Wheeler, but abandoned its attempt to destroy railroads and rescue Union prisoners of war.

zh.s: 巴克黑德溪之战又称巴克黑德溪战役或雷诺兹种植园之战，是谢尔曼向海进军期间的第二场战役，于1864年11月28日爆发。休·贾德森·基尔帕特里克准将率领的联邦军骑兵击退了约瑟夫·惠勒少将指挥的小股邦联骑兵部队，但放弃了摧毁铁路和营救联邦战俘的计划。

en.s: The Battle of Bonilla was a military engagement of the Ten Years' War. It took place on November 28, 1868, at Minas, in Puerto Príncipe (now Camagüey Province) in Cuba. After the Las Clavellinas Uprising in the province, the Spanish colonial government sent experienced military officers to quell the rebellion.

zh.s: 1868年11月28日，十年战争期间，古巴米纳斯（今卡马圭省）发生博尼利亚之战。拉斯克拉韦利纳斯起义后，西班牙殖民政府派遣经验丰富的军官前去镇压叛乱。

en.s: The Battle of Beaune-la-Rolande on 28 November 1870 took place during the Franco-Prussian War, which was won by Prussia. In an attempt to relieve the Siege of Paris, French General Crouzat's XX Corps launched an attack against three Prussian brigades resting in Beaune-la-Rolande. These brigades were from the Prussian X Corps which was detailed to guard the flanks and rear of the force besieging Paris and provide early warning of any French counter-attacks.

zh.s: 1870年11月28日，普法战争期间发生博讷拉罗朗德之战，最终普鲁士获胜。法国克鲁扎将军率领第20军团进攻驻扎在博讷拉罗朗德的3个普鲁士旅，试图为被围困的巴黎解围。这些部队来自普鲁士第10军团，负责守卫围困巴黎部队的侧翼和后方，并预警法国反攻。

en.s: The Battle of Dufile was fought at the fort of Dufile, Uganda on November 28, 1888 between Mahdist forces and a garrison loyal to the Khedive of Egypt. This followed a three-day siege in which the fort was penetrated and members of steamer crews were killed in the harbour. The 1200 garrison troops were led by Selim Bey while 1400 Mahdists were led by Umar Sālih. The Mahdists lost between 210 and 250 killed and retreated from the area for a period. Before the siege began, news of the approach of the Mahdists allowed the concentration of troops from other garrisons at Dufile.

zh.s: 1888年11月28日，马赫迪派军队与效忠埃及赫迪夫的驻军在乌干达杜菲莱堡交战。此前，马赫迪派围城三天，攻入堡内，并杀死停泊在港内的汽船船员。1200名守军由塞利姆·贝伊率领，1400名马赫迪派士兵由乌马尔·萨利赫率领。马赫迪派有210至250人阵亡，随后暂时撤离该地区。围城开始前，守军得知马赫迪派即将到来，得以从其他驻地调集部队到杜菲莱。

en.s: The 1893 New Zealand general election was held on 28 November and 20 December in the European and Māori electorates, respectively, to elect 74 MPs to the 12th session of the New Zealand Parliament. The election was won by the Liberal Party, and Richard Seddon became prime minister. 1893 was the year universal suffrage was granted to women over 21 (including Māori), plural registration was abolished, plural voting for Māori property-owners was abolished, and only those whose descent was exactly half Māori were allowed to choose whether to vote in European or Māori electorates.
en.n: Women's suffrage in New Zealand concludes with the 1893 New Zealand general election.

zh.s: 1893年新西兰大选于11月28日和12月20日分别在欧洲选区和毛利人选区举行，选出74名议员组成新西兰第12届议会。自由党赢得选举，理查德·塞登出任总理。1893年，21岁以上女性（包括毛利女性）获得普选权，重复登记被取消，毛利土地所有者的多重投票权也被废除；只有毛利血统恰为一半的人，才可以自行选择在欧洲选区或毛利人选区投票。
zh.n: 1893年新西兰大选结束女性参政权运动。

en.t: The Chicago Times-Herald race, the first automobile race in the U.S., was held in Chicago
en.s: The Chicago Times-Herald race was the first automobile race held in the United States. Sponsored by the Chicago Times-Herald, the race was held in Chicago in 1895 among six automobiles: four gasoline and two electric, all four-wheelers. It was won by Frank Duryea's Motorized Wagon. The race created considerable publicity for the motocycle, which had been introduced in the United States only two years earlier.

zh.t: 芝加哥时报先驱报汽车赛在芝加哥举行，是美国首场汽车比赛
zh.s: 芝加哥时报先驱报汽车赛是美国举行的首场汽车比赛。1895年，比赛由《芝加哥时报先驱报》赞助，在芝加哥举行，共有6辆汽车参赛，其中4辆使用汽油、2辆使用电力，且均为四轮车。弗兰克·杜里埃驾驶的机动车货车获胜。这场比赛为汽车带来广泛关注；这种车辆仅两年前才在美国问世。

en.s: The Battle of Modder River (Afrikaans: Slag van die Twee Riviere, lit. 'Battle of the Two Rivers', fought near the confluence of the Modder and Riet Rivers) was an engagement in the Boer War, fought at Modder River, on 28 November 1899. A British column under Lord Methuen, that was attempting to relieve the besieged town of Kimberley, forced Boers under General Piet Cronjé to retreat to Magersfontein, but suffered heavy casualties altogether.

zh.s: 莫德河之战又称“两河之战”，因发生在莫德河与里特河交汇处附近而得名，是布尔战争中的一场战斗，于1899年11月28日在莫德河畔打响。梅休因勋爵率领的英军纵队试图解围被围困的金伯利，迫使皮特·克龙涅将军率领的布尔人撤退到马格斯方丹，但英军伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Huddersfield by-election of 1906 was held on 28 November 1906. The by-election was held due to the incumbent Liberal MP, James Woodhouse, being appointed rail and canal traffic commissioner. It was won by the Liberal candidate Arthur James Sherwell.

en.s: The Albanian Declaration of Independence (Albanian: Deklarata e Pavarësisë) was the declaration of independence of Albania from the Ottoman Empire. Independent Albania was proclaimed in Vlorë on 28 November 1912. Six days later the Assembly of Vlorë formed the Provisional Government of Albania which was led by Ismail Qemali and the Council of Elders (Pleqnia).

zh.s: 阿尔巴尼亚独立宣言宣布阿尔巴尼亚脱离奥斯曼帝国独立。1912年11月28日，阿尔巴尼亚在发罗拉宣布独立。六天后，发罗拉议会成立阿尔巴尼亚临时政府，由伊斯梅尔·凯马利领导，并设立长老会（Pleqnia）。

en.t: Albania declares independence from the Ottoman Empire
en.s: On November 28, 1912, Ismail Qemali declared Albania's independence from the Ottoman Empire in Vlorë and raised the Albanian flag. The declaration marked the founding of an independent Albanian state.
en.n: This records the November 28 declaration; the Senate and government formed by the Assembly of Vlorë on December 4 are separate later milestones.

zh.t: 阿尔巴尼亚宣布脱离奥斯曼帝国独立
zh.s: 1912年11月28日，伊斯梅尔·捷马利在发罗拉宣布阿尔巴尼亚脱离奥斯曼帝国独立，并升起阿尔巴尼亚国旗。这一宣言标志着独立的阿尔巴尼亚国家成立。
zh.n: 此条记录11月28日宣布独立；议会于12月4日组建政府是之后的事。

en.s: The Battle of Prunaru was a military engagement between German and Romanian forces during the Romanian Campaign of World War I. It resulted in a tactical German victory, but following the heavy Romanian resistance the Germans halted after taking Prunaru. General Constantin Prezan's maneuver group checked the German forces in the region within two days, exposing the left flank of Field Marshal August von Mackensen's Danube Army.

zh.s: 普鲁纳鲁之战是第一次世界大战罗马尼亚战役期间德军与罗马尼亚军队的一场交战。德军取得战术胜利，但罗马尼亚军队顽强抵抗，德军占领普鲁纳鲁后便停止推进。两天内，君士坦丁·普雷赞将军率领的机动部队阻挡了当地德军，暴露了奥古斯特·冯·马肯森元帅多瑙河集团军的左翼。

en.s: The Estonian War of Independence, also known as the Estonian Liberation War, and War of Freedom in Estonia, was a defensive campaign of the Estonian Army and its allies, most notably the United Kingdom and Finland, against the Soviet Russian westward offensive of 1918–1919 and the 1919 aggression of the pro–German Baltische Landeswehr. The campaign was the struggle of the newly established democratic state of Estonia for independence in the aftermath of World War I.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚独立战争又称爱沙尼亚解放战争或自由战争，是爱沙尼亚军队及其盟友（尤以英国和芬兰为主）开展的防御战役，抵抗1918—1919年苏俄向西进攻，以及1919年亲德的波罗的海国防军侵略。这场战役是第一次世界大战后新成立的爱沙尼亚民主国家争取独立的斗争。

en.s: The British campaign in the Baltic 1918–1919 was a part of the Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War. The codename of the Royal Navy campaign was Operation Red Trek. The intervention played a key role in enabling the establishment of the independent states of Estonia and Latvia. It failed to secure the control of Petrograd by White Russian forces, which was one of the main goals of the campaign.

en.s: The Plymouth Sutton by-election, 1919 was a parliamentary by-election held on 28 November 1919 for the British House of Commons constituency of Sutton in the city of Plymouth, Devon. The seat had become vacant when the constituency's Conservative Member of Parliament (MP), Waldorf Astor, succeeded to the peerage as the second Viscount Astor on the death of his father on 18 October 1919. Astor had held the seat since the 1918 general election, and its predecessor Plymouth since the December 1910 general election.

zh.s: 1919年11月28日，英国下议院普利茅斯市德文郡萨顿选区举行补选。该席位因保守党议员沃尔多夫·阿斯特在父亲于1919年10月18日去世后继承爵位、成为第二代阿斯特子爵而空出。自1918年大选以来，阿斯特一直代表该选区；此前他自1910年12月大选起代表普利茅斯选区。

en.s: The Parliament of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland is the supreme legislative body of the United Kingdom. It meets at the Palace of Westminster in London. It is bicameral, consisting of the House of Commons and the House of Lords, with the sovereign forming a third constitutional element. Acting together to legislate, these constitute the King-in-Parliament.
en.n: Lady Astor is elected as a Member of the Parliament of the United Kingdom. She is the first woman to sit in the House of Commons. (Countess Markievicz, the first to be elected, refused to sit.)

zh.s: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国议会是英国最高立法机关，位于伦敦威斯敏斯特宫。议会实行两院制，由下议院和上议院组成，君主则构成第三个宪制要素。三者共同立法时，称为“国王会同议会”。

en.s: The Kilmichael ambush (Irish: Luíochán Chill Mhichíl) was an attack carried out on 28 November 1920 by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) near the village of Kilmichael, County Cork, during the Irish War of Independence. Thirty-six local IRA volunteers commanded by Tom Barry killed sixteen members of the Royal Irish Constabulary's Auxiliary Division. The Kilmichael ambush was politically as well as militarily significant.

zh.s: 1920年11月28日，爱尔兰共和军（IRA）在爱尔兰独立战争期间，于科克郡基尔迈克尔村附近发动袭击。汤姆·巴里率领36名当地IRA志愿兵，打死16名皇家爱尔兰警察辅助部队成员。这场伏击在政治和军事上都具有重要意义。

en.t: 1920 Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes Constitutional Assembly election
en.s: Constitutional Assembly elections were held in the recently proclaimed Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes (later renamed Yugoslavia) on 28 November 1920. The election was held in the context of political debate over the degree of centralisation or potential federalisation of Yugoslavia. The election was held in the entire territory of the country except the areas obtained shortly beforehand through the Treaty of Rapallo which regulated the borders with Italy because those areas were still under Italian occupation.

zh.t: 1920年塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国制宪议会选举
zh.s: 1920年11月28日，刚刚宣布成立的塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国举行制宪议会选举，该国后来改名为南斯拉夫。选举正值关于南斯拉夫应实行多大程度中央集权或联邦制的政治争论。意大利占领区未举行选举；这些地区不久前通过《拉帕洛条约》划定边界，仍处于意大利占领之下。

en.t: FIDAC (The Interallied Federation of War Veterans Organisations), the first international organization of war veterans is established in Paris, France

zh.t: 战后老兵组织国际联盟在巴黎成立
zh.s: 战后老兵组织国际联盟（FIDAC，法语全称Fédération Interalliée des Anciens Combattants）是首个国际老兵组织，于1920年11月在巴黎成立。该组织由第一次世界大战老兵发起，发起者以和平主义者为主，包括法国全国战斗人员联盟主任于贝尔·奥贝尔，尤其是该联盟秘书长、法国议会议员夏尔·贝特朗。

en.s: The Grand Ole Opry is a regular live country-music radio broadcast originating from Nashville, Tennessee, on WSM, held between two and five nights per week, depending on the time of year. It was founded on November 28, 1925, by George D. Hay as the WSM Barn Dance, taking its current name in 1927.
en.n: The Grand Ole Opry started as the WSM Barn Dance in the new fifth-floor radio studio of the National Life & Accident Insurance Company in downtown Nashville on November 28, 1925.

zh.s: 大奥普里是源自田纳西州纳什维尔、由WSM电台播出的乡村音乐现场广播节目，一年中每周直播两至五晚。1925年11月28日，乔治·D·海在国家人寿与意外保险公司位于纳什维尔市中心的新五楼录音室创办了节目，最初名为“WSM谷仓舞会”；1927年节目改用现名。

en.s: The 1934 FA Charity Shield was the 21st FA Charity Shield, a football match between the winners of the previous season's First Division and FA Cup competitions. The match was contested by league champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, and was played at Highbury, the home ground of Arsenal. Arsenal won the game, 4–0.

en.s: The 1937 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the sixth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1937 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Dublin won by a wide margin, having led 6–2 to 1–0 at half-time.

zh.t: 1937年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1937年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是第六届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该年度全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛的冠军决胜赛。这项跨郡赛事由爱尔兰顶级队伍参加。都柏林队大比分获胜，上半场以6比2领先1比0。

en.s: The Cocoanut Grove was a premier nightclub during the post-Prohibition 1930s and 1940s in Boston, Massachusetts. On November 28, 1942, this club was the scene of the deadliest nightclub fire in history, killing 492 people (which was 32 more than the building's authorized capacity) and injuring hundreds more. The scale of the tragedy shocked the nation and briefly replaced the events of World War II in newspaper headlines. It led to a reform of safety standards and codes across the US, and to major changes in the treatment and rehabilitation of burn victims internationally.

zh.s: 椰林夜总会是禁酒令结束后，20世纪30至40年代波士顿最有名的夜总会之一。1942年11月28日，这里发生了史上死亡人数最多的夜总会火灾，造成492人死亡（比建筑核准容纳人数多32人），数百人受伤。灾难震惊全美，一度盖过了报纸上的二战新闻。此事促使美国各地改革安全标准和法规，也推动国际上改进烧伤患者的治疗与康复。

en.s: The Battle of Réunion or Liberation of Réunion (French: Bataille de La Réunion or Libération de La Réunion) was an amphibious landing and uprising which brought the island of Réunion onto the Allied side during the Second World War. The invasion was performed by the Free French Naval Forces (FNFL) destroyer Léopard on 28 November 1942, which toppled the administration loyal to the Vichy French regime and replaced it with a Free French administration.

zh.s: 留尼汪战役又称留尼汪解放，是二战期间的一次两栖登陆和起义，使留尼汪岛转而加入同盟国一方。1942年11月28日，自由法国海军部队的驱逐舰“豹”号在岛上登陆，推翻了效忠维希法国的当局，改由自由法国接管。

en.s: The Tehran Conference (codenamed Eureka) was a strategy meeting of the Allies of World War II, held between Joseph Stalin, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill from 28 November to 1 December 1943. It was the first of the Allied World War II conferences involving the "Big Three" (the Soviet Union, the United States, and the United Kingdom) and took place at the Soviet embassy in Tehran more than two years after the Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran.

en.s: PSR B1919+21 is a pulsar with a period of 1.3373 seconds and a pulse width of 0.04 seconds. Discovered by Jocelyn Bell Burnell on 28 November 1967, it is the first-discovered radio pulsar. The power and regularity of its signal were briefly thought to resemble an extraterrestrial beacon, leading the source to be nicknamed LGM, later LGM-1 (for "little green men").

en.t: Wasfi al-Tal, Prime Minister of Jordan, is assassinated by the Black September unit of the Palestine Liberation Organization
en.s: Wasfi Tal (Arabic: وصفي التل; also known as Wasfi Tell; 1920 – 28 November 1971) was a Jordanian politician, statesman and military officer. en.s: The Mount Erebus disaster occurred on 28 November 1979 when Air New Zealand Flight 901 (TE901) flew into Mount Erebus on Ross Island, Antarctica, killing all 237 passengers and 20 crew on board. This flight left Auckland Airport in the morning and was supposed to spend a few hours flying over the Antarctic continent, before returning to Auckland in the evening via Christchurch.

en.s: STS-9 (also referred to Spacelab 1) was the ninth NASA Space Shuttle mission and the sixth mission of the Space Shuttle Columbia. STS-9 was also the last time the original STS numbering system was used until STS-26, which was designated in the aftermath of the 1986 Challenger disaster of STS-51-L.

en.s: Sir John Major (born 29 March 1943) is a British statesman who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and Leader of the Conservative Party from 1990 to 1997. en.t: Uruguay holds the second round of its 1999 presidential election
en.s: Uruguay held the second round of its presidential election on November 28, 1999, after no candidate won a majority in the October 31 general election. Jorge Batlle of the Colorado Party defeated Tabaré Vázquez of the Broad Front in the runoff. The vote was Uruguay's first presidential runoff under its revised electoral rules.

zh.s: 1999年11月28日，乌拉圭举行总统选举第二轮投票。此前10月31日的首轮选举无人获得过半选票。科罗拉多党的豪尔赫·巴特列在决选中击败广泛阵线的塔瓦雷·巴斯克斯。这是乌拉圭修改选举制度后首次举行总统选举第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2000 Intercontinental Cup, officially the 2000 Toyota European / South American Cup for sponsorship reasons, was an association football match played on 28 November 2000 between Real Madrid, winners of the 1999–2000 UEFA Champions League, and Boca Juniors, winners of the 2000 Copa Libertadores. The match was played at the neutral venue of the National Stadium in Tokyo in front of 52,511 fans.

en.s: Operation Accius is the Canadian military's contribution to the civilian-led United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA). On November 28, 2002, the Minister of National Defence John McCallum announced that a senior Canadian Forces officer by the name of Lieutenant Colonel David Ross would be deployed to Afghanistan (until June 2004) to serve as the military advisor to UNAMA. The UNAMA Military Advisory Unit comprises officers of the rank of Lieutenant-Colonel or equivalent from several nations, under the command of a Brigadier-General. Using the Kabul UNAMA office as a main base, the military liaison officers have several tasks, the most important of which is to provide timely military advice to the Kabul-based Special Representative to the Secretary-General.

zh.s: 阿修斯行动是加拿大军方对联合国阿富汗援助团（UNAMA）的军事支援。2002年11月28日，国防部长约翰·麦卡勒姆宣布，将派遣加拿大军官大卫·罗斯中校前往阿富汗，担任UNAMA军事顾问，任期至2004年6月。UNAMA军事顾问组由多个国家的中校或同等军衔军官组成，由一名准将指挥。联络军官以设在喀布尔的UNAMA办公室为主要基地，承担多项任务，最重要的是及时向驻喀布尔的秘书长特别代表提供军事建议。

en.s: The Okinawan gubernatorial election, 2010 was held on November 28, 2010. The official campaign start began November 11. en.t: Democratic Republic of the Congo general election, 2011
en.s: Presidential and parliamentary elections were held in Democratic Republic of the Congo on 28 November 2011; a facultative run-off on 26 February 2012 was shelved with a change in election laws. The government passed laws to abolish the second round of the presidential election and tried to change the legislative electoral system from proportional to majority representation, which has been strongly criticised by the opposition. Concerns have been raised about the transparency of the elections by a number of international organizations, which have called for an increase in the number of observers.

zh.s: 2011年11月28日，刚果民主共和国举行总统和议会选举。原计划于2012年2月26日举行的总统第二轮投票是可选环节，后来因选举法修改而取消。政府通过法律取消总统选举第二轮投票，并试图将议会选举制度从比例代表制改为多数制，遭到反对派强烈批评。多个国际组织对选举透明度表示担忧，并呼吁增加观察员人数。

en.s: The Axum massacre (alternatively spelled Aksum, also called the Maryam Ts'iyon massacre) was a massacre of about 100–800 civilians that took place in Axum during the Tigray War.
